steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 21
steps.text: In this B1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: That model is sold out until next month.
Can I try on this dress?
That size is out of stock right now.
